ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (>90% dark/black) with localized high-intensity (white) clusters creating high local contrast but low global white-to-black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented surface across both lobes; punctuated by non-contiguous, high-contrast white ovoid blobs (3-12 pixels in diameter) distributed randomly, with higher density in the mid-to-lower sections of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle; approximately 1/8th the total fluke height in bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular-amplitude serrations along the trailing boundary; right lobe distal edge exhibit extreme high-amplitude pixel variations resulting in a jagged, irregular profile compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips; the right lobe tip exhibits a localized abrupt change in trajectory due to edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous circular and ovoid white pixel clusters scattered across the dark ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the medial and distal regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower interior portion of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jaggedness and loss of smooth contour on the distal tip of the right fluke lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or amputation of the edge tissue.
